custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active, tracked part, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 5.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839480-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839480-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • A dark grey box with white text over four lines opens just below the (i) icon, over the switch and the Min box.
  • The heading "Inventory Tracking" stays visible above the box.
  • The text reads in full: "Tracked parts keep a stock count, with Min and Max. Turn this off for items you don't count. Untracked parts are left out of the Inventory Value report."

Step 4:

  • The box disappears and the switch and the Min box show again.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and part A's row shows again in the list, with its part number and description unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)
